screening_decisions.reason: Review/overview article on traumatic macular holes. Not a randomized controlled trial.
Literature review on retinal damage from ILM peeling. Not a primary RCT.
Systematic review and meta-analysis. The criteria require primary randomized controlled trials.
Prospective observational case series. Not an RCT.
Retrospective comparative study evaluating phacovitrectomy vs vitrectomy alone. Does not compare ILM peeling vs inverted ILM flap.
Meta-analysis of comparative studies. Not a primary RCT.
Expert consensus paper developing an OCT classification system. Not an RCT.
Retrospective comparative analysis of medical records. Not an RCT.
Retrospective longitudinal cohort study on incidence and risk factors. Not an RCT.
Meta-analysis of RCTs. Not a primary RCT.
Systematic review and single-arm meta-analysis. Not a primary RCT.
Review article on cataract pathophysiology. Not an RCT.
Experimental animal and cell culture study. Not a clinical RCT.
Population-based retrospective chart review. Not an RCT.
Methodology paper describing a risk-of-bias assessment tool. Not an RCT.
Literature review. Not an RCT.
RCT comparing two variations of the inverted ILM flap technique (classic vs modified). Does not compare inverted flap vs conventional ILM peeling.
Methodology paper on database search strategies. Not an RCT.
RCT comparing two variations of the inverted ILM flap technique (temporal vs classic). Does not compare inverted flap vs conventional ILM peeling.
Prospective RCT directly comparing standard ILM peeling vs inverted ILM flap technique for large idiopathic MHs (≥600 µm). Meets all selection criteria.
Observational comparative study. Not an RCT.
Review article on natural history and pathogenesis. Not an RCT.
Systematic review and meta-analysis. Not a primary RCT.
RCT comparing vitrectomy vs observation alone. Does not compare ILM peeling vs inverted ILM flap.
Epidemiological cross-sectional survey. Not an RCT.
RCT comparing standard vitrectomy with air vs inverted ILM flap technique. Does not compare ILM peeling vs inverted ILM flap as required by the criteria.
Retrospective case series on reopened MHs. Not an RCT.
Prospective comparative study (not randomized) comparing complete ILM removal vs inverted ILM flap. Lacks randomization.
Theoretical/short paper on MH pathogenesis. Not an RCT.
RCT comparing platelet-rich plasma vs inverted ILM flap. Does not compare ILM peeling vs inverted ILM flap.
Cross-sectional prevalence study. Not an RCT.
Statistical methodology paper. Not an RCT.
Editorial/review article. Not an RCT.
Expert consensus classification paper. Not an RCT.
Prospective RCT comparing multilayered inverted ILM flap vs standard ILM peeling for large MHs. Meets all selection criteria.
Observational study/review on stages of formation. Not an RCT.
Retrospective chart review on bilaterality rates. Not an RCT.
Prospective comparative study (not randomized) comparing inverted ILM flap vs conventional ILM peeling. Lacks randomization.
Prospective comparative study (not randomized) comparing ILM removal vs temporal inverted flap. Lacks randomization.
Prospective RCT directly comparing inverted ILM flap vs ILM peeling for large idiopathic FTMHs (600-1500 µm). Meets all selection criteria.
Statistical methodology paper on heterogeneity metrics. Not an RCT.
Review article. Not an RCT.
Meta-analysis of RCTs. Not a primary RCT.
Observational study/review on early stages and pathogenesis. Not an RCT.
RCT comparing two variants of inverted ILM flap (Cover vs Fill). Does not compare inverted flap vs conventional ILM peeling. Additionally, mean MH diameter was <400 µm.
RCT comparing inverted flap vs subretinal aspiration technique. Does not compare inverted flap vs conventional ILM peeling.
Literature review. Not an RCT.
Comparative study (not randomized) comparing ILM flat covering vs ILM stripping. Does not compare inverted flap vs peeling, and lacks randomization.
RCT comparing extended vs standard ILM dissection. Does not compare inverted flap vs conventional ILM peeling.
Epidemiological prevalence study on epiretinal membranes. Not an RCT.
